text: まけを　こわがって　たら　ポケモンは　できねえ　もんな！

structure.jp: まけを　こわがって　たら
ポケモンは　できねえ

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら means 'if'. Here it sits on こわがっている shortened to こわがってる, 'being scared'. こわがって たら = 'if you are being scared'.

patterns.name: 〜もの (reason)
patterns.explanation: もん is a casual もの that gives a reason, like 'because, after all', and な asks for agreement. できねえ is the rough form of できない. できねえ もんな = 'you can't do it, after all, right'.

patterns.name: 〜がる
patterns.explanation: がる on a feeling word like こわい means acting or showing that feeling. こわがって = 'being scared of'.
